question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Siddharth is floating a grand plan by next week.

options.text: Siddharth is being floated by a grand plan next week.
A grand plan is being floated by Siddharth next week.
Next week is keeping afloat by Siddharth’s grand plan.
A grand plan is being floating by Siddharth next week.

solution:
The correct answer is **"****A grand plan is being floated by Siddharth next week.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• There are a few things to keep in mind when changing a sentence from **active to passive voice**.

 
 
• The **subject **in the active voice becomes the **agent **in the passive voice. The agent is indicated with the preposition "**by**" in the given sentence.
 
• In the given sentence, "**Siddharth**" becomes the agent in a passive voice indicated with the preposition "**by**".
 
• The **object **in the active voice becomes the **subject **of the sentence in the passive voice.
 
• In the given sentence, "**A grand plan**" is the subject of the passive voice.
 
• The given sentence is in the **present continuous tense** so we need to use the **present participle **of "be" which is "**being**" in the passive voice sentence.
 
• The main verb "**floating**" of the given sentence will take the** past participle form (V3) **which is "**floated**" in the passive voice sentence.
 
 

 Hence the correct answer is** option 2 **

**The correct sentence is: * ****A grand plan is **being floated** by Siddharth next week.*
